# Flutter Leaf Kit - LLM Documentation

> A personal Flutter utility library

Repository: https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit

## Packages

Each package has its own LLM documentation index under `/llms/<package>/llms.txt`.

### leaf_component — UI Component Library

Themed UI components built on Atomic Design (atoms, molecules, organisms, templates) with a design-token-based theme system.

- [Documentation Index](https://github.com/JosephNK/flutter_leaf_kit/blob/main/llms/leaf_component/llms.txt)

### leaf_common — Common Utilities

Shared utilities, extension functions, logging, and exception handling used across all packages.

- Documentation: _coming soon_

### leaf_datetime — Date & Time

Date/time management and localization (Korean, English).

- Documentation: _coming soon_

### leaf_route — Page Navigation

Page navigation helpers and modal presentation utilities.

- Documentation: _coming soon_

### leaf_network — HTTP Networking

HTTP communication layer built on Dio with interceptors and response handling.

- Documentation: _coming soon_

### leaf_manager — App & Device Management

App lifecycle, device info, file management, and permission handling.

- Documentation: _coming soon_

### leaf_store — State & Storage

BLoC state management utilities and SharedPreferences helpers.

- Documentation: _coming soon_

### leaf_location — Location Services

Location information management built on Geolocator.

- Documentation: _coming soon_

### leaf_map — Google Maps

Google Maps integration for Flutter.

- Documentation: _coming soon_

### leaf_webview — WebView

WebView integration with controller and callback typedefs.

- Documentation: _coming soon_

### leaf — Umbrella Package

Re-exports all packages above for single-import convenience.

- Documentation: _coming soon_
